Happy Thanksgiving! Because Thanksgiving was yesterday, I figured I would reflect on the things I am thankful for this semester. Although there were most definitely a lot of challenges, I'm thankful for the support I found during these challenges. I also feel like because of the various challenges I faced, I was able to build deeper connections with my peers as we supported and helped each other through. Still, I cannot wait for the semester to be over. I've had enough challenges for one year!
